sentences.en: The bike was mangled in its collision with the truck.
sentences.zh: 这辆自行车在与卡车相撞后变得面目全非。

sentences.en: He recalled that a collision had been avoided by sheer luck.
sentences.zh: 他回忆起那次差点发生碰撞，完全是靠运气才避免了。

sentences.en: The Aegis collision - why couldn't it have been avoided?
sentences.zh: 阿吉斯的碰撞为何无法避免？

senses.zh: 碰撞，相撞；冲突，抵触；(意见、利益等的)的冲突，争执
